hosted-no-policy-host.title: The policy file is not published anywhere
hosted-no-policy-host.detail: MTA-STS needs the policy served over HTTPS at mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt. Enable policy hosting, or publish the file from your own web server and use the plain MTA-STS service instead.

hosted-wrong-policy-host.title: The policy host is not mta-sts.<domain> (found {{name}})
hosted-wrong-policy-host.detail: RFC 8461 fixes the policy host name: senders will only look for mta-sts.<domain>.

hosted-mode-mismatch.title: The served policy is in mode {{served}}, not {{configured}}
hosted-mode-mismatch.detail: {{url}} does not match what is configured here. The change may not have been applied to the zone yet, or DNS has not propagated.

hosted-mx-mismatch.title: The served policy lists different MX hosts
hosted-mx-mismatch.detail: {{url}} serves "{{served}}" where "{{configured}}" is configured here. The change may not have been applied to the zone yet, or DNS has not propagated.

mta-sts.title: MTA Strict Transport Security
mta-sts.intro: Tells other mail servers to only deliver to your domain over authenticated TLS. Beyond the DNS record, the standard needs a policy file served over HTTPS: happyDomain can host it for you.
mta-sts.mode-enforce: Enforce — refuse to deliver when TLS fails
mta-sts.max-age-desc: How long (in seconds) senders cache this policy. One week is the recommended minimum; up to one year is allowed.
mta-sts.mx-desc: Host names allowed to receive mail for this domain, as found in your MX records. A leading *. matches exactly one label.
mta-sts.host-policy: Let happyDomain serve the policy file (mta-sts. CNAME)
mta-sts.host-policy-desc: When enabled, happyDomain creates a CNAME for mta-sts.<your-domain> pointing to this happyDomain instance, which serves the policy below over HTTPS. Leave it off if you serve the file from your own web server.
mta-sts.preview-empty: Nothing will be served yet: testing and enforce policies need at least one authorized MX.

MTASTS.name: MTA-STS (hosted policy)
MTASTS.description: Require authenticated TLS for incoming mail, with the RFC 8461 policy file served by happyDomain.
